units.source_text: 他想把这诗写在那幅画上送给大公主。

en.t: He wanted to write this poem on that painting and send it to the Elder Princess.

units.source_text: 但念在这世间，自己这种念头略微吐露一点，便会引起绝大麻烦，

en.t: But he thought that in this world, if he revealed even a little of such feelings, it would bring terrible trouble,

units.source_text: 应该绝对不泄漏出去才是。

en.t: and that he must absolutely keep them from leaking out.

units.source_text: 如此左思右想，忧愁苦恨的结果，

en.t: After turning it over and over in his mind, grieving and suffering,

units.source_text: 终于记起了那个已死的宇治大女公子：

en.t: he finally remembered the Uji elder lady who had died:

units.source_text: “此人如果不死，我绝不会分心去爱别的女子。

en.t: "If she had not died, I would never have let my heart turn to another woman.

units.source_text: 即使当今皇上欲以公主赐我，我也不会领受。

en.t: Even if the present Emperor had wished to grant me a princess, I would not have accepted her.

units.source_text: 且皇上闻知我有如此钟爱之人，也不会将公主嫁我。

en.t: And if the Emperor had heard that I loved someone so dearly, he would not have married the princess to me.

units.source_text: 总之，害得我如此忧伤烦恼的，还是这‘宇治桥姬’！”

en.t: In the end, the one who has made me grieve and suffer so much is still this 'Uji Bridge Princess'!"

units.source_text: 如此苦思一番之后，又想到了那个匂亲王夫人，

en.t: After brooding in this painful way, he again thought of the lady who was now Prince Niou's wife,

units.source_text: 觉得又是可恋，又是可恨。

en.t: and felt that she was both lovable and hateful.

units.source_text: 当初自己让给了他，何等愚蠢！

en.t: How foolish he had been to yield her to him back then!

units.source_text: 现在追悔莫及了。

en.t: Now it was too late for regret.

units.source_text: 如此痛悔一番之后，又想到了那个突然死去的浮舟，

en.t: After regretting this so bitterly, he again thought of Ukifune, who had suddenly died,

units.source_text: 觉得此女年幼无知，不通世故，

en.t: and felt that she had been young and ignorant, with no understanding of the world,

units.source_text: 轻率地自丧性命，何其愚痴。

en.t: and that it had been terribly foolish of her to throw her life away so rashly.

units.source_text: 但又想起右近所述浮舟忧愁苦闷之状，

en.t: But then he remembered what Ukon had described of Ukifune's grief and anguish,

units.source_text: 以及闻知大将变志而负疚在心、悲伤饮泣之状，

en.t: and how, after learning that the General's feelings had changed, she had felt guilty, grieved, and wept,

units.source_text: 又觉得她很可怜。

en.t: and once more he felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 想道：“我本来不拟娶她为正妻，

en.t: He thought, "I never meant to take her as my principal wife;

units.source_text: 只当她是个忠贞可喜的情妇，

en.t: I only regarded her as a faithful and pleasing lover,

units.source_text: 这人实在是很可爱的。

en.t: and she truly was very dear.

units.source_text: 如此想来，匂亲王也不可恨，

en.t: Thinking of it this way, Prince Niou is not to be hated either,

units.source_text: 浮舟也不足怪，都是我自己不会处理世事之罪。”

en.t: and Ukifune is not really to blame; it is all my own fault for not knowing how to manage worldly affairs."

units.source_text: 他常常如此沉思冥想。

en.t: He often sank into thoughts like these.
